# Changelog

All notable changes to `@chaeulso/baileys` are documented here. This project follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html) and [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/).

## [7.3.3] — 2026-08-05

### Fixed

- 🚨 **richResponse array-form crash** — `richResponse` submessages with
  `code` as a STRING (or `table` rows as raw `string[][]`) crashed
  `toUnified` with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined
  (reading 'map')` (seen in production Termux logs, `.ai` code answers).
  New exported normalisers: `normalizeCodeBlocks` (string → tokenised
  blocks) & `normalizeTableRows` (string[][] → `{ isHeading, items }` rows);
  `toUnified` is additionally defensive.
- richResponse wrapped shape now matches the instantly-rendering AIRich
  reference exactly: `deviceListMetadata: {}` + `deviceListMetadataVersion: 2`,
  `botMetadata.richResponseSourcesMetadata: { sources: [] }`, unified body
  base64 in BOTH modes. Direct mode also carries device-list metadata —
  this field is required by consumer clients for AI/bot surfaces.


## [7.3.2] — 2026-08-05

### Added

- ⚡ **richResponse `direct: true` mode** — sends the AIRichResponseMessage as a
  TOP-LEVEL `Message.richResponseMessage` (field 97) with NO `botForwardedMessage`
  wrapper and NO forwarded marks/bot jid, plus the unified response body
  base64-encoded (reference-compatible). This bypasses the consumer-client
  *"can't verify the security of this media"* placeholder that stalled wrapped
  rich responses behind a manual Download tap. Only `botMetadata`
  (disclaimer / response id) stays at the message level.
  `unifiedEncoding: 'json' | 'base64'` knob exposed for experiments.


## [7.3.1] — 2026-08-04

### Fixed

- ⚡ **richResponse renders instantly** — placeholder `verificationMetadata` proofs (locally-random certificates) made official clients stall on certificate verification: the bubble sat on *"WhatsApp can't verify the security of this media"* for minutes before the rich content appeared. Proofs are now omitted by default; opt back in with `proof: true` in the send content, and `wrapToBotForwardedMessage(msg, { proof: true })`.
- The default forwarded-AI botJid is now the canonical `0@bot` (exported as `DEFAULT_BOT_JID`), overridable per send with `botJid`.

## [7.3.0] — 2026-08-04

Niche message-type expansion: every remaining high-value sending feature ported from `itsliaaa/baileys`, adapted to this fork's rules (no vendor fallbacks, defensive input validation, full typings, wire round-trip tests).

### Added

- 📌 **Keep chat** — `{ keep: message.key, type: 1|2 }` builds `keepInChatMessage` for chats with disappearing messages enabled.
- 💭 **Flow reply** — `{ flowReply: { text, name, paramsJson, ... } }` builds `interactiveResponseMessage` with a native-flow response body.
- 📊 **Poll suite** —
  - `poll.pollType: 1 (QUIZ)` + `correctAnswer` sends **quiz polls** (`pollCreationMessageV5`, newsletter-only),
  - `{ pollResult: { name, votes, pollType } }` sends `pollResultSnapshotMessage`/`V3`,
  - `{ pollUpdate: { key, vote } }` sends `pollUpdateMessage`,
  - extra poll fields now flow through: `endDate`→`endTime`, `hideVoter`→`hideParticipantName`, `canAddOption`→`allowAddOption`.
- 💳 **Payments** —
  - `{ paymentInviteServiceType: 1|2|3 }` sends `paymentInviteMessage`,
  - `{ text, requestPaymentFrom }` **wraps** a built text/sticker message into `requestPaymentMessage` (with a Boom on invalid note types),
  - `{ orderText, thumbnail }` sends `orderMessage` with neutral defaults (`orderTitle: 'Order'`) — every field overridable, no hardcoded vendor strings,
  - `{ image|document, invoiceNote }` sends `invoiceMessage` with the previously built attachment (Boom when no attachment).
- 📦 **Sticker packs** — `{ cover, stickers[], name?, publisher?, description? }` zips up to 60 WebP stickers (`fflate`), converts non-WebP inputs through **sharp or @napi-rs/image** to 512×512 WebP, uploads pack + 252×252 tray thumbnail as `sticker-pack`/`thumbnail-sticker-pack` media (`MEDIA_PATH_MAP`/`MEDIA_HKDF_KEY_MAPPING` extended), animated WebP detection (`ANIM`/`ANMF`/`VP8X`), 1 MB-per-sticker limit, optional `mediaCache` reuse.
- 🧾 **Rich response** — `{ code|table|links|richResponse, ... }` sends `botForwardedMessage` with an `AIRichResponseMessage`:
  - **code blocks** with syntax highlighting (`tokenizeCode` + `LEXER_REGEX` + `LANGUAGE_KEYWORDS` for 17 languages/aliases),
  - **tables** with heading rows + titles, **citation links** (`links[].url` is **required** — no vendor default), inline images, disclaimer text, LaTeX/content-item scaffolding, random verification-proof placeholders.
- 🖼️ **`@napi-rs/image` support** — third image-processing backend alongside sharp/jimp in `getImageProcessingLibrary` (now cached), wired into `extractImageThumb`, `generateProfilePicture`, and sticker-pack conversion. Optional dependency (`npm i @napi-rs/image`).
- 🧰 New types module `lib/Types/RichType.js` (`CodeHighlightType`, `RichSubMessageType`).
- 🔑 `encryptedStream` accepts an optional `mediaKey` to reuse an existing 32-byte key (sticker-pack thumbnail shares the pack key).
- 🗂️ `albumMessage` now accepts a raw media array (`{ album: [{image}, {video}] }`) and auto-counts images/videos (minimum 2), while keeping the explicit `{ expectedImageCount, expectedVideoCount }` object form.
- ✅ 16 new offline tests (107 total) covering every branch above with wire round-trips.

### Changed

- `scripts/build.mjs` marks `sharp`, `jimp`, `@napi-rs/image` as externals so the CJS bundle leaves dynamic native imports untouched.

## [7.2.0] — 2026-08-03

Interactive-message and wrapper-flag expansion ported from `itsliaaa/baileys`.

### Added

- 🧩 **Interactive builders** — `buttons`, `sections` (listMessage), `templateButtons`, `nativeFlow` (CTA url/copy/call/quick-reply/single-select with icons, `limited_time_offer`, `bottom_sheet`), `cards` (carousel), collection/shop storefront headers.
- 🎀 **Wrapper flags** — `externalAdReply` (short-hand link-ad, URL required), `groupStatus`, `spoiler` (new WAProto fields `Message.spoilerMessage` #118 + `ContextInfo.isSpoiler` #73), `interactiveAsTemplate`, `ephemeral`, `viewOnceV2`, `viewOnceV2Extension`, `isLottie`, `albumParentKey` contextInfo, `reportingToken`, `edit`, `mentions`/`mentionAll` on interactive messages. `raw: true` bypasses content generation and relays proto-shaped objects as-is.
- 🔐 **Biz attributes** — automatic `biz` binary node injection (`getBizBinaryNode`, `shouldIncludeBizBinaryNode`) for buttons/list/template/native-flow fanout, `secureMetaServiceLabel` flag, `ai` message label (`<bot biz_bot="1">` + support payload, private chats only).
- 🧑 **Identity helpers** — `sock.findUserId()` resolves PN↔LID pairs through the signal LID mapping store.
- 📰 `sock.newsletterSubscribed()` (mex `QueryIds.SUBSCRIBED`), enums `QueryIds.SUBSCRIBED`, `XWAPaths.xwa2_newsletter_subscribed`.
- 🗄️ **`makeInMemoryStore`** (full port: chats/contacts/messages via `@adiwajshing/keyed-db`, labels+associations, presence, group metadata, JSON `readFromFile`/`writeToFile`).
- 📇 `lib/Store` (in-memory) typings; `lib/Types/Message.d.ts` interactive content types (ButtonsMessageContent, ListMessageContent, TemplateButtonsMessageContent, InteractiveMessageContent, CarouselMessageContent, NativeFlowButton*, MessageWrappers, MessageSendFlags, ExternalAdReplyInfo).
- ✅ 25 new offline tests (91 total) + type-tests.

## [7.1.0] — 2026-08-02

The initial production‑ready fork. Base runtime: Baileys `7.0.0-rc13` (MIT), identity‑preserving dual ESM/CJS build from `Rifza123/baileys`.

### Highlights

- 🏷️ **Renamed** package to `@chaeulso/baileys` (drop‑in replacement for `@whiskeysockets/baileys`).
- 📦 Publishable package metadata, `exports` map, `files`, `engines` (+Node `>=20`).
- 🧬 **Full TypeScript declarations** for the entire public API (99 modules + `Newsletter`), type‑checked at **0 errors** (`tsc --strict`).
- 🛠️ **Reproducible CJS build** via a validated esbuild pipeline (`scripts/build.mjs`). Both entry points expose an identical export surface.
- 🧹 **Clean lint** (`eslint` flat config) at **0 errors**; removed unused imports, stale `typescript-eslint` directives, redundant casts, rethrow‑only catch clauses.
- 🧪 **66 offline tests** (`node --test`) covering: WABinary codec, JID utils, crypto, generics, **every message type (95+ proto fields round‑tripped)**, nested wrappers (view‑once/ephemeral/edited), quoted/forwarded contextInfo, event buffering, defensive/malformed parsing, serialization, auth/creds, CommonJS interop, reliability helpers.

### Added

- ✨ **Reliability & defensive helpers** (`lib/Utils/reliability.js`, fully typed): `TimeoutError`, `withTimeout`, `withRetry(backoff+jitter, abort signal, retry filter)`, `settle`, `safeAllSettled`, `isValidMessageKey`, `isWAMessage`, `getMessageContentKeys`, `getMessageTypeInfo`, `sanitizeIncomingMessage`.
- 📑 Comprehensive documentation: README, [MIGRATION](./MIGRATION.md), [docs/MESSAGE-TYPES](./docs/MESSAGE-TYPES.md), [docs/API](./docs/API.md), [docs/PERFORMANCE](./docs/PERFORMANCE.md).

### Changed

- ⬆️ `libsignal` moved from a git dependency to the **published** `libsignal@^6.0.0` (reliable installs). No API change.
- 📉 Removed unused `dotenv` dependency.
- 📄 Lock files regenerated for **npm**, **pnpm** and **yarn**.

### Compatibility

- Public API surface preserved: all 263 upstream exports remain, plus 10 additive reliability helpers (273 total).
- Node LTS · CommonJS · ESM · TypeScript · Bun · Deno(Node compat).
